instruction: Open 'character.png' in GIMP, rotate the image 90 degrees clockwise, and save the rotated image as 'character_rotated.png' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires rotating the square 1280x1280 image 90 degrees clockwise. Since it's square, dimensions remain 1280x1280. Evaluator checks the output file has correct dimensions (rotation preserved for square images).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies image rotation by comparing pixel data between original and rotated images
Uses correct 90-degree clockwise rotation formula: pixel at (x,y) in original should appear at (height-1-y, x) in rotated image
Samples 9 strategic points (corners, center, quarters) to verify rotation actually occurred
Properly handles square images where dimensions don't change after rotation
Includes robust error handling for missing files and file access issues
Allows reasonable tolerance for compression artifacts (up to 5 units per channel, max 1 mismatch out of 9 points)
Verifies all instruction requirements: rotation occurred (via pixel comparison) and file saved with correct name
